# remove looppointer

Drop [kyoh86/looppointer](https://github.com/kyoh86/looppointer) from the Go toolset (it was line 15 of `toolset/go.mod` at the time): the check is bundled into the author's `golangci-lint` fork ([[DOT-169]]), so the standalone binary is redundant — "I have personal work with it on a board".
